metadata.description: Community skills marketplace for Claude Code

plugins.name: genealogy
plugins.description: Parse, explore, and edit Gramps XML (.gramps) genealogy files. Use this skill whenever the user mentions a .gramps file, Gramps XML data, family trees, ancestry, genealogy research, lineage, ancestors, descendants, pedigree charts, or wants to look up relatives, trace family connections, or correct/update genealogical records.

plugins.name: wikidata-sparql
plugins.description: Query Wikidata via the SPARQL endpoint. Use whenever the user wants to find entities (people, films, places), look up Wikidata IDs or properties, disambiguate names, discover relationships between entities, or run knowledge-graph queries.
